"''Oh, you know. Most of the greats. Rothgar Deng. Boba Fett. Krrsantan. Emim'Ai…|Kief Varris and Rey|{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=14|story=Repair Stop, Part II}}}} '''Rothgar Deng''', possibly operating under an alias, was a [[Corellian]] [[bounty hunter]]. In an attempt to [[Immortality|live and work forever]], Deng subjected himself to [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] replacements, and turned to [[black market]] surgical clinics to replace damaged body parts. By the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], Deng was old and experienced, holding a reputation for being one of the greatest bounty hunters in the galaxy. According to a rumor, Deng was the bounty hunter [[Dengar]], who had a similar name, and, like Rothgar, had cybernetic surgeries.{{EncyclopediaCite|Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld}} At one point, [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] listed Deng as a bounty hunter that she claimed attempted to capture [[Moebin Faltus]]. However, when repeating the list, [[Kief Varris]] replaced Rothgar Deng's name with Dengar's. Deng was present on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] shortly before it was destroyed by the [[Sith Eternal]], but it was not known if he survived. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Rothgar Deng appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],{{Film|IX}} and was identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. While no explicit connection was made, Deng's name, background, and [[armor]] resemble that of{{SW|url=news/5-things-we-learned-from-the-star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-visual-dictionary|text=5 Things We Learned from the ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Visual Dictionary''}} the bounty hunter [[Dengar]], who similarly hailed from [[Corellia]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' The [[2020]] reference text ''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' provided further similarities, stating that Dengar became almost unrecognizable after undergoing extreme surgeries following the [[Galactic Civil War]].''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' The [[2021]] reference book "[[Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld]]" went even further, adding that an [[in-universe]] rumor stated that Deng was in fact Dengar. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Rothgar Deng}} *{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=14|story=Repair Stop, Part II}} {{Mo}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Rothgar Deng}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld}} *{{InsiderCite|219|Launchpad}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *''[[The Art of Star Wars: Outlaws]]'' {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Rothgar Deng |es=Rothgar Deng |fr=Rothgar Deng |ja=ロスガー・デング |ka=როთგარ დენგი |pl=Rothgar Deng }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Deng, Rothgar}} [[Category:Bounty hunters]] [[Category:Corellians]] [[Category:Cyborgs]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
